title: Impinge
summary: IMPINGE, verb intransitive impinj'. [Latin impingo; in and pango, to strike. See Pack.] To fall against; to strike; to dash against; to clash upon. The cause of reflection is not the impinging of ligh

inlines.v: IMPINGE, verb intransitive impinj'. [Latin impingo; in and pango, to strike. See Pack.] To fall against; to strike; to dash against; to clash upon. The cause of reflection is not the impinging of light on the solid or impervious parts of bodies.
